title: Weekly Activation Trend
instructions: Create a product analytics visual that explains trend quality, not just growth.

analysis.headline: Activation improved for eight straight weeks
analysis.narrative: New account volume increased 81%, while activated accounts grew 159%, lifting activation rate from 44.8% to 63.9%. Growth quality improved alongside volume.

insights.label: Quality improved faster than volume
insights.explanation: Activated accounts grew nearly twice as fast as new accounts.

insights.label: No weekly regression
insights.explanation: Activation rate rose every week in the sample.

recommended_visuals.title: New vs activated accounts
recommended_visuals.purpose: Show that activation growth outpaced account growth.

analysis.layout_guidance: Use a product analytics panel with a large activation-rate trend and supporting volume comparison.
warnings: This is sample data for concept testing.
